name: Pasta
intro: Roast the delicata on Sunday and this is a ten-minute dinner any night after. Butter, sage, squash, lemon.
season_options: White beans, warmed in the butter
Black pepper, a lot of it

variations.context: Melt the butter with the sage until it smells like toast, then fold in the squash.
Heartier. The beans turn creamy in the pasta water.

finish: Save a mug of pasta water. Butter and parmesan need it to become a sauce rather than a coating. Lemon zest goes on off the heat.
